name: spo-aspx-page-type-audit
title: SharePoint Online ASPX Page Type Audit
shortDescription: Audits SharePoint Online page libraries and classifies ASPX pages as Modern or Classic.
longDescription: This script audits ASPX pages in a SharePoint Online page library and classifies each page as Modern or Classic based on the ClientSideApplicationId field.
It is designed for governance and modernization reviews, helping administrators identify legacy classic pages that may require further assessment.
